name: Priya Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1976, Priya Limited trades in Electronics and Chemicals.
keyPoints:
Products & Services:[1]
Company is a part of the Priya Group. Company is a distributor of computer peripherals and systems and also a exporter              of dyes and pharmaceuticals. Company exports Intermediates like naphthalene and benzene derivatives, pyrazolines, pigment intermediates, naphthol, fast bases and  some specialty/anti-cancer drugs. Apart from this, company's IT products portfolio includes few hardware components and some software titles.

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
